# Security policy

## Supported versions

Only the latest release of axellsdojo.com gets security fixes. Please update before you report: the newest version is always
on the [releases page](https://github.com/zmardanian/axellsdojo.com/releases/latest) and on [axellsdojo.com](https://www.axellsdojo.com).

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please **do not open a public issue** for a security problem. Report it privately instead:

- on GitHub: [Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/zmardanian/axellsdojo.com/security/advisories/new) (private, only the maintainer can see it), or
- by email: contact@axellsdojo.com

Please include what you found, how to reproduce it, and the version and operating system you used. You will get an
answer within 7 days. Fixes for confirmed problems are released as soon as they are ready, and the advisory is
published with credit to you, unless you would rather stay anonymous.

## What counts

- the website www.axellsdojo.com and its download counter (/get/)
- anything that could serve a visitor a wrong or modified download
